div.div:
Colours: grey retina emulator (fixed) · green LGN relay (fixed) · blue ventral / form-colour · orange dorsal / motion · purple selection, attention, PFC · yellow outputs
Learning: flat STDP in S1–S4 and S2*, exponential STDP in motion path, R-STDP in IT fine-tune and readout, fixed MST templates; adaptive threshold θi ← θi + ηθ(zi − ρ) in every S layer
